name: Vaultwarden
author: dani-garcia

control._comment: Single container, embedded SQLite vault; nothing to order.

description: Self-hosted password vault, Bitwarden-compatible — the official Bitwarden browser extension, desktop and mobile apps all work, pointed at this server instead of Bitwarden's. One container, SQLite, tiny. The admin panel ships OFF (no ADMIN_TOKEN): it is an unnecessary surface on a vault, and enabling it needs an interactive terminal because `vaultwarden hash` will not run without a TTY. The setup script cannot create your account — the master password derives the vault key in the browser and must never reach the server — so signups stay open until you register, and re-running setup.sh closes them. ⚠️ Nothing backs this box up: losing ~/services/vaultwarden loses every password. Keep a client-side encrypted export somewhere else.
